title: Report select control
responsibility: Provides a labeled native selection control with shared report styling.

inputs.name: Select.value
inputs.description: Optional bindable selected value, defaulting to an empty string.

inputs.name: Select.label
inputs.description: Required accessible label for the select.

inputs.name: Select.required
inputs.description: Optional native required flag, omitted by default.

inputs.name: Select.disabled
inputs.description: Optional disabled state, defaulting to false.

inputs.name: Select.children
inputs.description: Required snippet supplying the option markup.

inputs.name: Select.compact
inputs.description: Optional compact size for dense navigation. Defaults to false; coarse-pointer targets remain larger.

inputs.name: Select.display
inputs.description: Optional closed-field label. Names over 16 characters show their first and last six characters. Native options and bound values stay complete.

inputs.name: Select.title
inputs.description: Optional hover text. Defaults to the full display label.

outputs.name: Select
outputs.description: Native select with a decorative arrow. Binding updates its selected value; disabled and required behavior follow the browser. Forced-color mode restores the native appearance.
